subject: maths
question: An athelete runs 8 times around a circular field of radius 14 m in 2 minutes 56 seconds. Find his speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Number of rounds = 8

The radius of the circular field = 14 m

Total time of running = 2 minutes 56 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Circumference of circle = 2πR

Where R = radius of the circle 

**Calculation:**

Circumference of field = 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 88 m

⇒ Total distance covered in 8 round = 8 × 88 = 704 m 

Total time taken = 2 min 56 sec = 176 sec

Speed = Distance/time = 704/176 = 4 m/sec

**∴ The speed of the athlete is 4 m/sec.**
